citations.quote: The CMR will apply to an RA 13 licensed corporation (LC) and its associated entity (AE) in respect of “scheme money” received or held in Hong Kong by the RA 13 LC or its AE in the course of conducting Type 13 regulated activity by the RA 13 LC, only when such LC is not acting as a Transfer Agent.

readings.distinction: Entity-wide attachment: “not” negates the LC’s acting as a Transfer Agent, and “only when” restricts the entire preceding applicability statement. On this reading, concurrent Transfer Agent activity defeats the selected antecedent even for other RA13 money handling. The LC remains the grammatical subject of the role restriction when its AE handles the money.

citations.quote: Would activities that an RA 13 depositary performs in its capacity as a Transfer Agent (TA) (eg, processing payments in designated accounts) be subject to requirements under the CMR?
only when such LC is not acting as a Transfer Agent

In such cases, the depositary is expected to observe relevant requirements under Schedule 11 to the Code of Conduct for Persons Licensed by or Registered with the Securities and Futures Commission (Schedule 11), in particular paragraphs 9 (relating to how subscription and redemption proceeds should be held) and 11 (relating to distribution proceeds).

readings.distinction: Activity-specific attachment: the negation still applies to acting as a Transfer Agent, but the preceding question restricts the relevant capacity to the money handling being examined. This is contextually preferable because Q1 expressly asks about activities performed in that capacity. The text does not conclusively settle concurrent mixed-capacity cases. Neither parse supports moving “not” onto scheme-money status or converting “only when” into an alternative disjunct.

vocabulary_concerns: transfer_agent does not specify a transaction, funds, capacity or evaluation time. It cannot distinguish the two readings in concurrent mixed-capacity cases without an additional scoped fact or an expressly clarified definition.

The vocabulary contains no Schedule 11 duty facts. Q1’s “In such cases” follows its non-scheme-money discussion; the text does not expressly extend that sentence to every Transfer Agent exclusion. Failure of this antecedent therefore establishes neither absence nor satisfaction of Schedule 11 duties.
The incorporated definitions and missing dependency are not supplied substantively. The scheme_money classification remains an external judgment, not a conclusion established by this Boolean.
